import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Generates tests/Nro.Tests/Items/item-model.json: reference results of the REAL Java item model for the C# port (track D, items and rewards).
 * Run with: java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -Duser.timezone=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh ItemModelGenerator.java <output.json>
 *
 * This file is GENERATED by port-csharp/tools/item-model/gen_harness.py. The classes Item, ItemOption, ItemService, RewardService, ItemTemplate and ItemOptionTemplate below are the ORIGINAL
 * bodies from SRC_6 (package line and imports removed, "public" dropped from the class line); the only text changes are listed in the "substitutions" line of the JSON meta:
 *   new Random()  ->  Harness.rnd()   (the shared stream that Util.nextInt also uses, seeded per case, so the Java run is replayable)
 *   Collections.shuffle(list)  ->  Collections.shuffle(list, Harness.rnd())
 *   System.currentTimeMillis()  ->  Harness.now()   (a clock the scenario sets)
 *   Date.from(Instant.now())  ->  new Date(Harness.now())
 * The Util/TimeUtil/CombineUtil methods the classes call are copied verbatim; the other game classes (Manager, Player, InventoryService, Service, ItemMap, shops) are small stubs that record
 * what the original code asks them to do.
 */
public class ItemModelGenerator {

    static final String[] SOURCES = {
        "models/Item/Item.java|dd7d22c13cfc5da4d047c961d02bd7dd0d5e1ddc87946393aafa9c63806f4e27|578",
        "models/Item/ItemOption.java|f81215f113d0691f916d19c5953898a322be5453256fa88ba40e0c51ff49ad78|67",
        "models/Item/ItemService.java|6de52ae5792b59f321364129adee29e547667760ce440164d14f265c4b515ff3|1652",
        "models/Reward/RewardService.java|1394d577507aa2d1ad712af0c213dee197e8bd3a28715291ab0767d0318b693b|980",
        "models/Item/ItemTime.java|f925d405157ff4273df288db0a62d426b7c55a215235de40eacd92b82c2146e8|822",
        "models/Item/ItemTimeService.java|135bdd6ba50ece22ca90f5329a622840176d68045a41014443233bf148e12a57|737",
        "nro/template/ItemTemplate.java|5606c195f0c7e32ad9c01c9dd4e3e5992a06002913a732f65c45914123a5ae75|85",
        "nro/template/ItemOptionTemplate.java|dec61f9ef6448bf4f5a0d1f669b91558884c38eae4f42173b64a4f10f01bdf55|31",
        "Utils/Util.java|61a48bd8c76e272c1d032b2e163bd4745871eedad8657669ac644a187356e832|896",
        "Utils/TimeUtil.java|5d08476bd14b934efb440dadefe6b5246f2a00d3054509974c2e7f836a8b1720|383",
        "nro/combine/CombineUtil.java|44138470848184c8f1caf83a46fe524deff1bff42755a9f2559a568dd6b66cf5|422",
    };

    static final long BASE_NOW = 1735664400000L; // 2025-01-01 00:00 Vietnam time

    static final int[][] GEAR_TYPES = {
        {555, 557, 559, 650, 652, 654, 1048, 1049, 1050},
        {556, 558, 560, 651, 653, 655, 1051, 1052, 1053},
        {562, 564, 566, 657, 659, 661, 1054, 1055, 1056},
        {563, 565, 567, 658, 660, 662, 1057, 1058, 1059},
        {561, 656, 1060, 1061, 1062},
    };

    static final int TEMPLATES = 1900;
    static final int OPTIONS = 300;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // catalog
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    static byte gearType(int id) {
        for (int t = 0; t < GEAR_TYPES.length; t++) {
            for (int x : GEAR_TYPES[t]) {
                if (x == id) {
                    return (byte) t;
                }
            }
        }
        return (byte) ((id * 7 + 3) % 40);
    }

    static void buildCatalog() {
        Manager.ITEM_OPTION_TEMPLATES.clear();
        Manager.ITEM_TEMPLATES.clear();
        Manager.SHOPS.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < OPTIONS; i++) {
            Manager.ITEM_OPTION_TEMPLATES.add(new ItemOptionTemplate(i, "Opt" + i + " #", 0));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < TEMPLATES; i++) {
            ItemTemplate t = new ItemTemplate();
            t.id = (short) i;
            t.type = gearType(i);
            t.gender = (byte) (i % 4);
            t.level = (byte) (i % 16);
            t.name = "Item" + i;
            t.strRequire = i * 10;
            t.iconID = (short) (i + 1000);
            Manager.ITEM_TEMPLATES.add(t);
        }
    }

    /** One shop with one tab; the entries are listed in SHOP_ENTRIES so that the C# test can rebuild it. */
    static final List<int[]> SHOP_ENTRIES = new ArrayList<>(); // {templateId, optionId1, param1, optionId2, param2, ...}

    static void buildShop() {
        SHOP_ENTRIES.clear();
        int[] plain = {5, 6, 7, 100, 555, 556, 557, 562, 563, 561, 650, 651, 1048, 1049};
        for (int id : plain) {
            SHOP_ENTRIES.add(new int[]{id, 47, 100 + id % 50, 21, 5, 0, 200 + id % 7});
        }
        SHOP_ENTRIES.add(new int[]{9});
        SHOP_ENTRIES.add(new int[]{9, 6, 99});
        // one level-14 entry for every (gender, type) the formulas allow, so getAngelItem finds the shop piece
        for (int g = 0; g <= 3; g++) {
            for (int ty = 0; ty <= 4; ty++) {
                for (int id = 0; id < TEMPLATES; id++) {
                    if (id % 16 == 14 && id % 4 == g && gearType(id) == ty) {
                        SHOP_ENTRIES.add(new int[]{id, 47, 50 + g, 22, 40 + ty, 0, 17 + g + ty, 21, 33});
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Shop shop = new Shop();
        TabShop tab = new TabShop();
        shop.tabShops.add(tab);
        for (int[] e : SHOP_ENTRIES) {
            ItemShop is = new ItemShop();
            is.temp = Manager.ITEM_TEMPLATES.get(e[0]);
            for (int k = 1; k + 1 < e.length; k += 2) {
                is.options.add(new ItemOption(Manager.ITEM_OPTION_TEMPLATES.get(e[k]), e[k + 1]));
            }
            tab.itemShops.add(is);
        }
        Manager.SHOPS.add(shop);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // dump helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    static String dump(List<ItemOption> l) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (ItemOption io : l) {
            if (sb.length() > 0) {
                sb.append(',');
            }
            sb.append(io.optionTemplate.id).append(':').append(io.param);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    static String dumpItem(Item it) {
        return (it.template == null ? "-" : String.valueOf(it.template.id)) + "x" + it.quantity + "|" + dump(it.itemOptions) + "|" + it.createTime + "|" + it.info + "|" + it.content;
    }

    static String log() {
        String s = String.join(";", Harness.log);
        Harness.log.clear();
        return s;
    }

    static String exc(Throwable t) {
        return "EXC:" + t.getClass().getSimpleName();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // json
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    static final StringBuilder JSON = new StringBuilder();
    static int caseCount = 0;

    static String esc(String s) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("\"");
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '"' || c == '\\') {
                sb.append('\\').append(c);
            } else if (c < 0x20 || c > 0x7e) {
                sb.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
            } else {
                sb.append(c);
            }
        }
        return sb.append('"').toString();
    }

    static void emit(String name, long seed, String args, String result) {
        if (caseCount++ > 0) {
            JSON.append(",\n");
        }
        JSON.append("[").append(esc(name)).append(",").append(seed).append(",").append(esc(args)).append(",").append(esc(result)).append("]");
    }

    interface Body {
        String run() throws Exception;
    }

    static void run(String name, long seed, String args, Body body) {
        Harness.reset(seed);
        String result;
        try {
            result = body.run();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            result = exc(t);
        }
        emit(name, seed, args, result);
    }

    static long ago(String v) {
        return v.equals("neg") ? -1 : Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(v);
    }

    static void applyProfile(Player p, String prof) {
        if (prof.equals("none")) {
            return;
        }
        for (String kv : prof.split(",")) {
            String[] x = kv.split("=");
            String k = x[0];
            String v = x.length > 1 ? x[1] : "";
            switch (k) {
                case "fus": {
                    String[] fv = v.split("@");
                    p.fusion.typeFusion = Byte.parseByte(fv[0]);
                    p.fusion.lastTimeFusion = Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(fv[1]);
                    break;
                }
                case "cum": p.effectSkill.iscumber = true; p.effectSkill.lastTimeUpcumber = ago(v); break;
                case "cum2": p.effectSkill.iscumber2 = true; p.effectSkill.lastTimeUpcumber2 = ago(v); break;
                case "pain": p.effectSkill.isPain = true; p.effectSkill.lastTimeUpPain = ago(v); break;
                case "kef": p.effectSkill.iskefla = true; p.effectSkill.lastTimeUpkefla = ago(v); break;
                case "clan": p.clan = new Clan(); break;
                case "gone": p.clan.haveGoneDoanhTrai = true; break;
                case "dt": p.clan.lastTimeOpenDoanhTrai = Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(v); break;
                case "bdkb": p.clan.lastTimeOpenBanDoKhoBau = Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(v); break;
                case "cdrd": p.clan.lastTimeOpenConDuongRanDoc = Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(v); break;
                case "kg": p.clan.lastTimeOpenKhiGasHuyDiet = Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(v); break;
                case "boss": p.clan.lastTimeOpenBossOfTheGangs = Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(v); break;
                case "round": p.clan.boss_clan_round = Integer.parseInt(v); break;
                case "dtp": {
                    p.clan.doanhTrai = new DoanhTraiState();
                    p.clan.doanhTrai.isTimePicking = !v.equals("neg");
                    p.clan.doanhTrai.lastTimePick = v.equals("neg") ? 0 : Harness.now() - Long.parseLong(v);
                    break;
                }
                default: throw new IllegalArgumentException(k);
            }
        }
    }

    static Item item(int id, int... opts) {
        Item it = new Item();
        it.template = ItemService.gI().getTemplate(id);
        it.quantity = 1;
        it.createTime = Harness.now();
        for (int k = 0; k + 1 < opts.length; k += 2) {
            it.itemOptions.add(new ItemOption(opts[k], opts[k + 1]));
        }
        return it;
    }

    static String optString(int[] o) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int k = 0; k + 1 < o.length; k += 2) {
            if (sb.length() > 0) {
                sb.append(',');
            }
            sb.append(o[k]).append(':').append(o[k + 1]);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        buildCatalog();
        buildShop();
        ItemService svc = ItemService.gI();
        RewardService rew = RewardService.gI();
        final int SEEDS = 8;

        // ---- drops ----
        for (long s = 1; s <= SEEDS; s++) {
            run("randDoTLBoss", s, "", () -> {
                ItemMap m = svc.randDoTLBoss(new Zone(), 1, 0, 0, 1L);
                return m.itemTemplate.id + "|" + dump(m.options);
            });
            run("randDoTL", s, "", () -> {
                ItemMap m = svc.randDoTL(new Zone(), 1, 0, 0, 1L);
                return m.itemTemplate.id + "|" + dump(m.options);
            });
            for (int id : new int[]{555, 556, 557, 558, 559, 560, 561, 562, 563, 564, 565, 566, 567, 1, 0}) {
                final int fid = id;
                run("getDefaultOptionTL", s, "" + id, () -> dump(svc.getDefaultOptionTL(fid)));
            }
            for (int id : new int[]{555, 556, 562, 563, 561, 650, 651, 657, 658, 656, 5, 1799}) {
                final int fid = id;
                run("otpts", s, "" + id, () -> dumpItem(svc.otpts((short) fid, 3)));
                run("otptl", s, "" + id, () -> dumpItem(svc.otptl((short) fid, 3)));
                run("otphd", s, "" + id, () -> dumpItem(svc.otphd((short) fid, 3)));
            }
            for (int g : new int[]{-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4}) {
                final int fg = g;
                run("randomSKHId", s, "" + g, () -> String.valueOf(svc.randomSKHId((byte) fg)));
            }
            for (int[] a : new int[][]{{5, 127}, {555, 128}, {5, 250}, {9, 255}, {5, 300}}) {
                final int[] fa = a;
                run("itemSKH", s, a[0] + "," + a[1], () -> dumpItem(svc.itemSKH(fa[0], fa[1])));
            }
            for (int id : new int[]{650, 651, 652, 653, 654, 655, 657, 658, 659, 660, 661, 662, 656, 700}) {
                for (int g = 0; g <= 2; g++) {
                    final int fid = id, fg = g;
                    run("randomCS_DHD", s, id + "," + g, () -> dumpItem(svc.randomCS_DHD(fid, fg)));
                }
            }
            for (int id : new int[]{1048, 1049, 1050, 1051, 1052, 1053, 1054, 1055, 1056, 1057, 1058, 1059, 1060, 1061, 1062, 700}) {
                for (int g = 0; g <= 2; g++) {
                    final int fid = id, fg = g;
                    run("DoThienSu", s, id + "," + g, () -> dumpItem(svc.DoThienSu(fid, fg)));
                }
            }
            for (int g : new int[]{0, 1, 2, 3, 5}) {
                final int fg = g;
                run("randTempItemKichHoat", s, "" + g, () -> String.valueOf(svc.randTempItemKichHoat(fg)));
                run("randTempItemKichHoat_VIP", s, "" + g, () -> String.valueOf(svc.randTempItemKichHoat_VIP(fg)));
            }
            for (int g : new int[]{-1, 0, 1, 2, 3}) {
                final int fg = g;
                run("randOptionItemKichHoat", s, "" + g, () -> Arrays.toString(svc.randOptionItemKichHoat(fg)));
            }
            int[][] shopSets = {{47, 100, 21, 5}, {231, 1}, {210, 3}, {210, 20}, {76, 1, 47, 2, 164, 1, 249, 1}, {231, 1, 210, 2, 47, 9}, {}};
            for (int[] set : shopSets) {
                final int[] fs = set;
                run("createItemFromItemShop", s, "5;" + optString(set), () -> {
                    ItemShop is = new ItemShop();
                    is.temp = svc.getTemplate(5);
                    for (int k = 0; k + 1 < fs.length; k += 2) {
                        is.options.add(new ItemOption(fs[k], fs[k + 1]));
                    }
                    return dumpItem(svc.createItemFromItemShop(is));
                });
            }
        }

        // ---- deterministic tables ----
        {
            StringBuilder a = new StringBuilder();
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
            for (int id = -2; id <= 301; id++) {
                a.append(svc.optionIdSKH(id)).append(',');
                b.append(svc.optionIdDHD(id)).append(',');
            }
            emit("optionIdSKH", 0, "-2..301", a.toString());
            emit("optionIdDHD", 0, "-2..301", b.toString());
        }
        for (int g : new int[]{-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4}) {
            final int fg = g;
            run("randOptionItemKichHoatNew", 0, "" + g, () -> Arrays.toString(svc.randOptionItemKichHoatNew(fg)));
        }
        for (int[] a : new int[][]{{14, 0, 0}, {14, 1, 2}, {14, 2, 4}, {14, 3, 4}, {13, 1, 2}, {15, 0, 0}, {14, 3, 0}, {14, 0, 1}}) {
            final int[] fa = a;
            run("getListOptionItemShop3", 0, a[0] + "," + a[1] + "," + a[2], () -> dump(svc.getListOptionItemShop(fa[0], fa[1], fa[2])));
        }
        for (int id : new int[]{5, 6, 9, 10, 555, 1048, 1049, 1050, 3}) {
            final int fid = id;
            run("getListOptionItemShop1", 0, "" + id, () -> dump(svc.getListOptionItemShop((short) fid)));
            run("getOptionParamItemShop", 0, id + ",47", () -> String.valueOf(svc.getOptionParamItemShop((short) fid, 47)));
            run("getOptionParamItemShop", 0, id + ",6", () -> String.valueOf(svc.getOptionParamItemShop((short) fid, 6)));
            run("getOptionParamItemShop", 0, id + ",21", () -> String.valueOf(svc.getOptionParamItemShop((short) fid, 21)));
        }
        for (int g = 0; g <= 3; g++) {
            for (int ty = 0; ty <= 5; ty++) {
                final int fg = g, ft = ty;
                run("getAngelItem", 0, g + "," + ty, () -> dumpItem(svc.getAngelItem(fg, ft)));
            }
        }
        for (int id : new int[]{529, 534, 530, 535, 531, 536, 1797, 532, 1}) {
            final int fid = id;
            run("trainArmor", 0, "" + id, () -> {
                Item it = item(fid);
                return svc.getPercentTrainArmor(it) + "," + svc.isTrainArmor(it);
            });
        }
        run("trainArmorNull", 0, "", () -> svc.getPercentTrainArmor(null) + "," + svc.isTrainArmor(null));

        // ---- expiry ----
        int[][] expirySets = {{93, 5}, {260, 10}, {261, 100}, {93, 3, 260, 50}, {93, 1, 260, 2, 261, 3}, {260, 5, 261, 100}, {47, 10}, {93, 1}, {261, 1, 93, 9}};
        long[] ageMinutes = {0, 1, 5, 59, 60, 61, 90, 1439, 1440, 1441, 2880, 2880 + 190, 4320, 14400, -1440, -2880};
        for (int[] set : expirySets) {
            for (long age : ageMinutes) {
                final int[] fs = set;
                final long fa = age;
                run("isOutOfDateTime", 0, optString(set) + ";age=" + age, () -> {
                    Harness.nowMs = BASE_NOW;
                    Item it = item(5, fs);
                    it.createTime = BASE_NOW - fa * 60000L;
                    boolean r = svc.isOutOfDateTime(it);
                    return r + "|" + dump(it.itemOptions) + "|" + (it.createTime - BASE_NOW);
                });
                run("loadItemTimeStatus", 0, optString(set) + ";age=" + age, () -> {
                    Harness.nowMs = BASE_NOW;
                    Item it = item(5, fs);
                    it.createTime = BASE_NOW - fa * 60000L;
                    svc.loadItemTimeStatus(new Player(), it);
                    return dump(it.itemOptions) + "|" + (it.createTime - BASE_NOW) + "|" + log();
                });
            }
        }
        run("isOutOfDateTimeNull", 0, "", () -> String.valueOf(svc.isOutOfDateTime(null)));

        // ---- Item predicates over many templates ----
        {
            List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();
            int[][] ranges = {{0, 70}, {10, 40}, {350, 380}, {405, 450}, {520, 540}, {540, 570}, {640, 670}, {920, 970}, {1040, 1090}, {1205, 1215}, {1270, 1285}, {1295, 1310}, {1365, 1385},
                {1410, 1440}, {1790, 1800}, {1895, 1900}};
            for (int[] r : ranges) {
                for (int i = r[0]; i < r[1]; i++) {
                    if (!ids.contains(i)) {
                        ids.add(i);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int id : ids) {
                final int fid = id;
                run("itemPredicates", 0, "" + id, () -> {
                    Item it = item(fid);
                    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                    sb.append(it.isDTS() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDTL() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDHD() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDHD1() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDTLNew() ? 1 : 0)
                            .append(it.isManhThienSu() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDaMayMan() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDaNangCapTS() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isCongThuc() ? 1 : 0)
                            .append(it.isCongThucVip() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDaNangCap() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isSachTuyetKy() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isSachTuyetKy2() ? 1 : 0)
                            .append(it.isDaPhaLeEpSao() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDaPhaLeC1() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDaPhaLeC2() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDaPhaLeMoi() ? 1 : 0)
                            .append(it.isDaPhaLeCu() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isTypeBody() ? 1 : 0).append(it.canPhaLeHoa() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDoKyGui() ? 1 : 0)
                            .append(it.isItemCollection() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isItemTemplateToPet() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isItemTemplateToPlayer() ? 1 : 0)
                            .append(it.isTrangBiPSH() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isTrangBiKhoaGd() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isTrangBiHacHoa() ? 1 : 0);
                    sb.append('|').append(it.typeName()).append('|').append(it.getGenderName()).append('|').append(it.typeManh());
                    sb.append('|').append(it.getInfo()).append('|').append(it.getContent()).append('|').append(it.Name());
                    for (int stoneId : new int[]{223, 222, 224, 221, 220, 5}) {
                        sb.append(it.canNangCapWithNDC(item(stoneId)) ? 1 : 0);
                    }
                    return sb.toString();
                });
            }
        }

        // ---- option sets ----
        int[][] optionSets = {{}, {47, 10}, {50, 36}, {50, 35}, {77, 100, 21, 5}, {5, 36}, {103, 36}, {127, 1}, {135, 1}, {136, 1}, {93, 0}, {93, -1}, {260, 5}, {86, 1}, {87, 1},
            {47, 10, 47, 20, 21, 5}, {0, 100, 6, 50, 7, 7, 14, 3, 21, 80, 22, 5, 23, 6, 27, 7, 28, 8}, {30, 1, 72, 2, 73, 1, 102, 1, 107, 1, 218, 3, 50, 30, 21, 4}, {50, 7, 50, 8}};
        for (int[] set : optionSets) {
            for (int tid : new int[]{5, 555, 556}) {
                final int[] fs = set;
                final int ftid = tid;
                run("itemOptionPredicates", 0, tid + ";" + optString(set), () -> {
                    Item it = item(ftid, fs);
                    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                    sb.append(it.isBUg() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isSKH() ? 1 : 0).append(it.haveSetKichHoat() ? 1 : 0).append(it.isTrangBiHSD() ? 1 : 0)
                            .append(it.isHaveOption(47) ? 1 : 0).append(it.haveOption(30) ? 1 : 0).append(it.isDoKyGui() ? 1 : 0);
                    sb.append('|').append(it.getOptionParam(47)).append('|').append(it.getInfo()).append('|').append(it.getOptionInfo()).append('|').append(it.getOptionInfoUpgrade())
                            .append('|').append(it.getOptionInfoUpgradeFinal()).append('|').append(dump(it.cloneItem().itemOptions));
                    for (int stone : new int[]{14, 16, 20, 441, 447, 1416, 1426, 1433, 1434, 300}) {
                        String r;
                        try {
                            r = it.getOptionInfo(item(stone, 1, 1)) + "#" + it.getOptionInfoCuongHoa(item(stone, 1, 1));
                        } catch (Throwable t) {
                            r = exc(t);
                        }
                        sb.append('|').append(r);
                    }
                    return sb.toString();
                });
            }
        }
        for (int[] set : optionSets) {
            final int[] fs = set;
            run("stoneDefaultOption", 0, optString(set), () -> {
                Item it = item(300, fs);
                ItemOption io = it.getOptionDaPhaLe();
                return io.optionTemplate.id + ":" + io.param;
            });
        }
        for (int stone : new int[]{14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 441, 442, 443, 444, 445, 446, 447, 1416, 1417, 1418, 1419, 1420, 1421, 1422, 1426, 1427, 1428, 1429, 1430, 1431, 1432, 1433, 1434}) {
            final int fs = stone;
            run("stoneOption", 0, "" + stone, () -> {
                ItemOption io = item(fs, 1, 1).getOptionDaPhaLe();
                return io.optionTemplate.id + ":" + io.param;
            });
        }

        // ---- percent of the shop value and the transfer preview ----
        for (int tid : new int[]{5, 6, 7, 100, 555, 556, 557, 562, 563, 561, 650, 651, 1048, 1049}) {
            for (int[] set : new int[][]{{47, 100}, {47, 50, 72, 1}, {47, 111, 72, 1}, {6, 40}, {0, 205}, {7, 17, 72, 2}, {14, 17}, {47, 0}, {47, 99999999, 72, 3}}) {
                final int ftid = tid;
                final int[] fs = set;
                run("getPercentOption", 0, tid + ";" + optString(set), () -> String.valueOf(item(ftid, fs).getPercentOption()));
                run("getOptionInfoChuyenHoa", 0, tid + ";" + optString(set), () -> {
                    Item target = item(5, 47, 200, 21, 5, 0, 1000, 6, 77, 7, 9);
                    return target.getOptionInfoChuyenHoa(item(ftid, fs), 3) + "|" + dump(target.itemOptions);
                });
            }
        }

        // ---- editing sequences ----
        String[] sequences = {"add:47:5", "add:47:5;add:47:5;add:21:80", "set:47:99;set:30:1", "sub:47:4;sub:30:4", "subrm:47:10;subrm:47:0", "subrm:47:-3", "rm:47;rm:99;rm:47", "get:47:3;get:30:1",
            "add:47:2147483647;add:47:1", "add:300:1", "add:-1:1", "set:299:5"};
        for (String seq : sequences) {
            final String fseq = seq;
            run("itemEdits", 0, seq, () -> {
                Item it = item(5, 47, 10, 21, 5, 47, 3);
                for (String op : fseq.split(";")) {
                    String[] p = op.split(":");
                    int a = Integer.parseInt(p[1]);
                    int b = p.length > 2 ? Integer.parseInt(p[2]) : 0;
                    switch (p[0]) {
                        case "add": it.addOptionParam(a, b); break;
                        case "set": it.setOptionParam(a, b); break;
                        case "sub": it.subOptionParam(a, b); break;
                        case "subrm": it.subOptionParamAndRemoveIfZero(a, b); break;
                        case "rm": it.removeOption(a); break;
                        case "get": it.getOptionParam(a, b); break;
                    }
                }
                return dump(it.itemOptions);
            });
        }

        // ---- copies ----
        run("copyAndClone", 0, "", () -> {
            Item it = item(5, 47, 10, 21, 5);
            it.info = "i";
            it.content = "c";
            it.quantity = 7;
            it.quantityGD = 3;
            Item copy = svc.copyItem(it);
            Item clone = it.cloneItem();
            copy.itemOptions.get(0).param = 1;
            clone.itemOptions.get(1).param = 2;
            return dumpItem(it) + "#" + dumpItem(copy) + "#" + dumpItem(clone) + "#" + copy.quantityGD + clone.quantityGD;
        });

        // ---- RewardService option rules ----
        for (long s = 1; s <= 2; s++) {
            for (int type = -1; type <= 5; type++) {
                for (int id = 0; id < TEMPLATES; id++) {
                    final int ftype = type, fid = id;
                    Harness.reset(s);
                    List<ItemOption> list = new ArrayList<>();
                    String result;
                    try {
                        rew.initBaseOptionClothes(fid, ftype, list);
                        result = dump(list);
                    } catch (Throwable t) {
                        result = exc(t);
                    }
                    if (!result.isEmpty() || (id < 3 && s == 1)) {
                        emit("initBaseOptionClothes", s, id + "," + type, result);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int id : new int[]{441, 442, 443, 444, 445, 446, 447, 220, 221, 222, 223, 224, 225, 440, 448, 1, 226}) {
            final int fid = id;
            run("initBaseOptionSaoPhaLe", 0, "" + id, () -> {
                Item it = item(fid, 47, 1);
                rew.initBaseOptionSaoPhaLe(it);
                return dump(it.itemOptions);
            });
        }
        for (long s = 1; s <= 12; s++) {
            for (int g = -1; g <= 3; g++) {
                for (int type : new int[]{0, 3, 4, 5, 9}) {
                    final int fg = g, ft = type;
                    run("initActivationOption", s, g + "," + type, () -> {
                        List<ItemOption> l = new ArrayList<>();
                        rew.initActivationOption(fg, ft, l);
                        return dump(l);
                    });
                }
            }
            int[][][] stars = {{{1, 1, 2}}, {{3, 0, 100}, {7, 100, 100}}, {{2, 50, 100}, {4, 25, 100}, {6, 1, 1000}}, {{1, -1, 5}}, {{1, 5, 0}}};
            for (int si = 0; si < stars.length; si++) {
                final int[][] fst = stars[si];
                run("initStarOption", s, "set" + si, () -> {
                    RewardService.RatioStar[] arr = new RewardService.RatioStar[fst.length];
                    for (int k = 0; k < fst.length; k++) {
                        arr[k] = new RewardService.RatioStar((byte) fst[k][0], fst[k][1], fst[k][2]);
                    }
                    Item it = item(5);
                    rew.initStarOption(it, arr);
                    return dump(it.itemOptions);
                });
            }
        }

        // ---- reward packs ----
        for (long s = 1; s <= 40; s++) {
            for (int slots : new int[]{0, 3}) {
                final int fslots = slots;
                String[] names = {"rewardTuanLoc", "rewardBeNa", "rewardPiLong", "rewardMeoDen", "rewardLancon"};
                for (String name : names) {
                    final String fname = name;
                    run(name, s, "slots=" + slots, () -> {
                        Player p = new Player();
                        Harness.emptySlots = fslots;
                        switch (fname) {
                            case "rewardTuanLoc": rew.rewardTuanLoc(p); break;
                            case "rewardBeNa": rew.rewardBeNa(p); break;
                            case "rewardPiLong": rew.rewardPiLong(p); break;
                            case "rewardMeoDen": rew.rewardMeoDen(p); break;
                            default: rew.rewardLancon(p); break;
                        }
                        return log() + "|" + p.canReward_TuanLoc + p.haveReward_TuanLoc + p.canReward_PeNa + p.haveReward_PeNa + p.canReward_PiLong + p.haveReward_PiLong
                                + p.canReward_MeoDen + p.haveReward_MeoDen + p.canReward + p.haveReward;
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        long[] loginOffsetsMin = {-30, -600, -1200, -1441, -2000, -100000};
        for (long off : loginOffsetsMin) {
            final long foff = off;
            run("rewardFirstTimeLoginPerDay", 0, "offsetMin=" + off, () -> {
                Harness.nowMs = BASE_NOW + 8 * 3600000L; // 08:00 Vietnam time
                Player p = new Player();
                p.firstTimeLogin = new Date(Harness.nowMs + foff * 60000L);
                rew.rewardFirstTimeLoginPerDay(p);
                return log() + "|" + (p.firstTimeLogin.getTime() - Harness.nowMs);
            });
        }

        // ---- settl* / sethd* packs ----
        String[] packNames = {"settlkaio", "settlgenki", "settlson", "settlpico", "settloctieu", "settlpiko", "settlgalick", "settlcadick", "settlnappa", "sethdkaio", "sethdgenki", "sethdson", "sethdpico",
            "sethdoctieu", "sethdpiko", "sethdcadick", "sethdcadic", "sethdnappa"};
        for (String pn : packNames) {
            for (int slots : new int[]{0, 1, 2, 4, 5}) {
                for (long s = 1; s <= 3; s++) {
                    for (boolean hasPack : new boolean[]{true, false}) {
                        final String fpn = pn;
                        final int fslots = slots;
                        final boolean fhas = hasPack;
                        run(pn, s, "slots=" + slots + ",pack=" + hasPack, () -> {
                            Player p = new Player();
                            Harness.emptySlots = fslots;
                            Harness.bag.clear();
                            if (fhas) {
                                Harness.bag.put(fpn.startsWith("settl") ? 1703 : 1704, item(fpn.startsWith("settl") ? 1703 : 1704));
                            }
                            ItemService.class.getMethod(fpn, Player.class).invoke(svc, p);
                            return log();
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // ---- openDTS ----
        int[][] combineSets = {{555, 650, 651}, {562, 657, 658}, {566, 661, 662}, {561, 656, 650}, {555, 650}, {650, 651, 652}, {555, 650, 651, 652}, {555, 556, 650}, {567, 662, 651}, {564, 653, 655}};
        for (long s = 1; s <= 3; s++) {
            for (int[] set : combineSets) {
                for (int g = 0; g <= 2; g++) {
                    for (int slots : new int[]{0, 2}) {
                        final int[] fs = set;
                        final int fg = g, fslots = slots;
                        run("openDTS", s, Arrays.stream(set).boxed().map(String::valueOf).collect(Collectors.joining("+")) + ";g=" + g + ";slots=" + slots, () -> {
                            Player p = new Player();
                            p.gender = (byte) fg;
                            Harness.emptySlots = fslots;
                            for (int id : fs) {
                                p.combine.itemsCombine.add(item(id));
                            }
                            svc.openDTS(p);
                            return log();
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // ---- ItemTime.update and ItemTimeService ----
        java.lang.reflect.Field[] allFields = ItemTime.class.getFields();
        List<java.lang.reflect.Field> boolFields = new ArrayList<>();
        List<java.lang.reflect.Field> longFields = new ArrayList<>();
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field f : allFields) {
            if (java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(f.getModifiers())) {
                continue;
            }
            if (f.getType() == boolean.class) {
                boolFields.add(f);
            } else if (f.getType() == long.class) {
                longFields.add(f);
            }
        }
        boolFields.sort(Comparator.comparing(java.lang.reflect.Field::getName));
        longFields.sort(Comparator.comparing(java.lang.reflect.Field::getName));
        long[] deltas = {0, 1, 3000, 3001, 5000, 5001, 10000, 10001, 30000, 30001, 60000, 60001, 120000, 120001, 180000, 180001, 600000, 600001, 900000, 900001, 1200001, 1800000, 1800001, 3000001, 3600000,
            3600001, 5400001, 7200001, 9000001, 86400000, 86400001};
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field flag : boolFields) {
            final java.lang.reflect.Field fflag = flag;
            run("itemTimeUpdate", 0, flag.getName(), () -> {
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (long d : deltas) {
                    Harness.reset(0);
                    Player p = new Player();
                    ItemTime t = p.itemTime;
                    for (java.lang.reflect.Field lf : longFields) {
                        lf.setLong(t, Harness.now() - d);
                    }
                    t.timeTDLT = 60000;
                    fflag.setBoolean(t, true);
                    t.update();
                    sb.append(d).append(fflag.getBoolean(t) ? ":1" : ":0");
                    String lg = log();
                    if (!lg.isEmpty()) {
                        sb.append('/').append(lg);
                    }
                    sb.append(' ');
                }
                return sb.toString().trim();
            });
        }
        run("itemTimeUpdateAll", 0, "", () -> {
            Player p = new Player();
            ItemTime t = p.itemTime;
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field lf : longFields) {
                lf.setLong(t, Harness.now() - 100000000L);
            }
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field bf : boolFields) {
                bf.setBoolean(t, true);
            }
            t.timeTDLT = 1000;
            t.update();
            StringBuilder left = new StringBuilder();
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field bf : boolFields) {
                if (bf.getBoolean(t)) {
                    left.append(bf.getName()).append(',');
                }
            }
            return log() + "|" + left;
        });
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field flag : boolFields) {
            final java.lang.reflect.Field fflag = flag;
            run("sendAllItemTime", 0, "flag=" + flag.getName(), () -> {
                Player p = new Player();
                ItemTime t = p.itemTime;
                for (java.lang.reflect.Field lf : longFields) {
                    lf.setLong(t, Harness.now() - 100000);
                }
                t.timeTDLT = 180000;
                t.iconMeal = 4242;
                fflag.setBoolean(t, true);
                ItemTimeService.gI().sendAllItemTime(p);
                return log();
            });
        }
        run("sendAllItemTime", 0, "flag=ALL", () -> {
            Player p = new Player();
            ItemTime t = p.itemTime;
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field lf : longFields) {
                lf.setLong(t, Harness.now() - 100000);
            }
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field bf : boolFields) {
                bf.setBoolean(t, true);
            }
            t.timeTDLT = 180000;
            t.iconMeal = 4242;
            ItemTimeService.gI().sendAllItemTime(p);
            return log();
        });
        run("clearAllItemTime", 0, "flags=ALL", () -> {
            Player p = new Player();
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field bf : boolFields) {
                bf.setBoolean(p.itemTime, true);
            }
            ItemTimeService.gI().clearAllItemTime(p);
            StringBuilder left = new StringBuilder();
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field bf : boolFields) {
                if (bf.getBoolean(p.itemTime)) {
                    left.append(bf.getName()).append(',');
                }
            }
            return log() + "|" + left;
        });
        run("clearAllItemTime", 0, "flags=NONE", () -> {
            ItemTimeService.gI().clearAllItemTime(new Player());
            return log();
        });
        for (int minutes : new int[]{0, 3, 100000}) {
            for (long elapsed : new long[]{0, 61000, 300000}) {
                final int fm = minutes;
                final long fe = elapsed;
                run("tdlt", 0, "minutes=" + minutes + ";elapsedMs=" + elapsed, () -> {
                    Player p = new Player();
                    Item it = item(5, 1, fm);
                    ItemTimeService.gI().turnOnTDLT(p, it);
                    String on = log() + "|" + p.itemTime.isUseTDLT + "," + p.itemTime.timeTDLT + "," + dump(it.itemOptions);
                    Harness.nowMs += fe;
                    ItemTimeService.gI().turnOffTDLT(p, it);
                    return on + "|" + log() + "|" + p.itemTime.isUseTDLT + "," + dump(it.itemOptions);
                });
            }
        }
        for (int[] sample : new int[][]{{4167, 30}, {70000, -100}, {1, 32768}, {2, -32769}, {0, 0}}) {
            final int[] fsm = sample;
            run("sendItemTime", 0, sample[0] + "," + sample[1], () -> {
                ItemTimeService.gI().sendItemTime(new Player(), fsm[0], fsm[1]);
                return log();
            });
            run("sendTextTime", 0, sample[0] + ",Xin chào," + sample[1], () -> {
                ItemTimeService.gI().sendTextTime(new Player(), (byte) fsm[0], "Xin chào", fsm[1]);
                return log();
            });
        }
        // profiles: fus=<type>@<ago>, cum/cum2/pain/kef=<ago or neg>, clan=1, gone=1, dt/bdkb/cdrd/kg/boss=<ago>, dtp=<agoPick>, round=<n>
        String[] profiles = {"none", "fus=4@100000", "fus=3@100000", "cum=60000,cum2=neg,pain=0,kef=100000", "clan=1", "clan=1,dt=100000,bdkb=100000,cdrd=100000,kg=100000,boss=100000,round=4",
            "clan=1,gone=1,dt=1000", "clan=1,dt=0", "clan=1,dt=1800000,bdkb=1500000,cdrd=1200000,kg=900000,boss=1800000", "clan=1,dt=1801000,bdkb=1501000,cdrd=1201000,kg=901000,boss=1801000",
            "clan=1,dt=-2000,bdkb=-2000,cdrd=-2000,kg=-2000,boss=-2000", "clan=1,dtp=20000", "clan=1,dtp=130000", "clan=1,dtp=neg", "clan=1,dt=500000,dtp=60000,round=1"};
        for (String prof : profiles) {
            final String fprof = prof;
            for (String fn : new String[]{"sendAll", "sendTextDoanhTrai", "sendTextTimePickDoanhTrai", "sendTextBanDoKhoBau", "sendTextConDuongRanDoc", "sendTextKhiGasHuyDiet", "sendTextMapBossBangHoi"}) {
                final String ffn = fn;
                run("itemTimeProfile", 0, fn + ";" + prof, () -> {
                    Player p = new Player();
                    applyProfile(p, fprof);
                    ItemTimeService s = ItemTimeService.gI();
                    switch (ffn) {
                        case "sendAll": s.sendAllItemTime(p); break;
                        case "sendTextDoanhTrai": s.sendTextDoanhTrai(p); break;
                        case "sendTextTimePickDoanhTrai": s.sendTextTimePickDoanhTrai(p); break;
                        case "sendTextBanDoKhoBau": s.sendTextBanDoKhoBau(p); break;
                        case "sendTextConDuongRanDoc": s.sendTextConDuongRanDoc(p); break;
                        case "sendTextKhiGasHuyDiet": s.sendTextKhiGasHuyDiet(p); break;
                        default: s.sendTextMapBossBangHoi(p); break;
                    }
                    return log();
                });
            }
        }
        run("textHelpers", 0, "", () -> {
            Player p = new Player();
            ItemTimeService s = ItemTimeService.gI();
            s.sendTextXinbato(p);
            s.removeTextDoanhTrai(p);
            s.removeTextBanDoKhoBau(p);
            s.removeTextConDuongRanDoc(p);
            s.removeTextKhiGasHuyDiet(p);
            s.removeTextMapBossBangHoi(p);
            s.removeItemTime(p, 2755);
            s.sendCanAutoPlay(p);
            p.itemTime.isUseTDLT = true;
            s.sendCanAutoPlay(p);
            return log();
        });

        // ---- write ----
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        out.append("{\n\"meta\": {\"jdk\": ").append(esc(System.getProperty("java.version"))).append(", \"timezone\": ").append(esc(System.getProperty("user.timezone")))
                .append(", \"templates\": ").append(TEMPLATES).append(", \"options\": ").append(OPTIONS).append(", \"baseNow\": ").append(BASE_NOW)
                .append(", \"substitutions\": ").append(esc("new Random() x33, Collections.shuffle(availableIds) x1, System.currentTimeMillis() x108, Date.from(Instant.now()) x2, import static ItemTime.* qualified x95")).append(", \"sources\": [");
        for (int i = 0; i < SOURCES.length; i++) {
            out.append(i > 0 ? "," : "").append(esc(SOURCES[i]));
        }
        out.append("], \"gearTypes\": [");
        for (int t = 0; t < GEAR_TYPES.length; t++) {
            out.append(t > 0 ? "," : "").append(Arrays.toString(GEAR_TYPES[t]));
        }
        out.append("], \"shop\": [");
        for (int i = 0; i < SHOP_ENTRIES.size(); i++) {
            out.append(i > 0 ? "," : "").append(Arrays.toString(SHOP_ENTRIES.get(i)));
        }
        out.append("]},\n\"cases\": [\n").append(JSON).append("\n]\n}\n");
        try (Writer w = new OutputStreamWriter(new FileOutputStream(args[0]), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            w.write(out.toString());
        }
        System.out.println("cases: " + caseCount);
    }
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// harness state and stubs (NOT original code)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Harness {
    static long nowMs = ItemModelGenerator.BASE_NOW;
    static int emptySlots = 10;
    static final Map<Integer, Item> bag = new HashMap<>();
    static final List<String> log = new ArrayList<>();

    static void reset(long seed) {
        Util.rand.setSeed(seed);
        nowMs = ItemModelGenerator.BASE_NOW;
        emptySlots = 10;
        bag.clear();
        log.clear();
    }

    static Random rnd() {
        return Util.rand;
    }

    static long now() {
        return nowMs;
    }
}

class Util {
    static final Random rand = new Random(0);

    public static int nextInt(int from, int to) {
        return from + rand.nextInt(to - from + 1);
    }

    public static int nextInt(int max) {
        return rand.nextInt(max);
    }

    public static boolean isTrue(int ratio, int typeRatio) {
        if (typeRatio <= 0 || ratio <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        if (ratio >= typeRatio) {
            return true;
        }
        return Util.nextInt(typeRatio) < ratio;
    }

    public static int highlightsItem(boolean highlights, int value) {
        double highlightsNumber = 1.1;
        return highlights ? (int) (value * highlightsNumber) : value;
    }

    public static boolean canDoWithTime(long lastTime, long miniTimeTarget) {
        return Harness.now() - lastTime > miniTimeTarget;
    }

    public static String replace(String text, String regex, String replacement) {
        return text.replace(regex, replacement);
    }


    public static boolean isAfterDay(Date now, Date when) {
        try {
            java.text.DateFormat df = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
            Date d1 = df.parse(df.format(now));
            Date d2 = df.parse(df.format(when));
            return d1.after(d2);
        } catch (java.text.ParseException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

class TimeUtil {
    public static final byte SECOND = 1;
    public static final byte MINUTE = 2;
    public static final byte HOUR = 3;
    public static final byte DAY = 4;
    public static final byte WEEK = 5;
    public static final byte MONTH = 6;
    public static final byte YEAR = 7;

    public static long diffDate(Date d1, Date d2, byte type) {
        long timeDiff = Math.abs(d1.getTime() - d2.getTime());
        switch (type) {
            case SECOND:
                return (timeDiff / 1000);
            case MINUTE:
                return (timeDiff / (60 * 1000) % 60);
            case HOUR:
                return (timeDiff / (60 * 60 * 1000) % 24);
            case DAY:
                return (timeDiff / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            case WEEK:
                return (timeDiff / (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            case MONTH:
                return (timeDiff / (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            case YEAR:
                return (timeDiff / (365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            default:
                return 0;
        }
    }


}

class CombineUtil {
    public static int pointUp(int n, int iters) {
        for (int i = 0; i < iters; i++) {
            n += Math.max(n / 10, 1);
        }
        return n;
    }

    public static int reversePoint(int n, int iters) {
        int[] interValues = new int[iters + 1];
        interValues[iters] = n;
        for (int i = iters; i > 0; i--) {
            int prevValue = interValues[i];
            int subValue = prevValue / 11;
            interValues[i - 1] = prevValue - subValue;
        }
        return interValues[0];
    }


}

class Player {
    byte gender;
    Combine combine = new Combine();
    Inventory inventory = new Inventory();

    boolean canReward_TuanLoc, haveReward_TuanLoc, canReward_PeNa, haveReward_PeNa, canReward_PiLong, haveReward_PiLong, canReward_MeoDen, haveReward_MeoDen, canReward, haveReward;
    ItemTime itemTime = new ItemTime(this);
    NPoint nPoint = new NPoint();
    Fusion fusion = new Fusion();
    EffectSkill effectSkill = new EffectSkill();
    Clan clan;

    void sendMessage(Message msg) {
        StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte b : msg.bytes()) {
            hex.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        }
        Harness.log.add("msg:" + msg.cmd + ":" + hex);
    }
}

/** Stub of network.io.Message: same big-endian data stream the real one wraps. */
class Message {
    final int cmd;
    private final java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
    private final java.io.DataOutputStream dos = new java.io.DataOutputStream(bos);

    Message(int cmd) {
        this.cmd = cmd;
    }

    java.io.DataOutputStream writer() {
        return dos;
    }

    byte[] bytes() {
        return bos.toByteArray();
    }

    void cleanup() {
    }
}

    private static final InventoryService I = new InventoryService();

        return I;
    }

    Item findItem(List<Item> list, int tempId) {
        return Harness.bag.get(tempId);
    }

    int getCountEmptyBag(Player p) {
        return Harness.emptySlots;
    }

    void addItemBag(Player p, Item it) {
        Harness.log.add("add:" + ItemModelGenerator.dumpItem(it));
    }

    void sendItemBag(Player p) {
        Harness.log.add("bag");
    }

    void subQuantityItemsBag(Player p, Item it, int q) {
        Harness.log.add("sub:" + (it == null ? "null" : String.valueOf(it.template.id)) + ":" + q);
    }
}
